signatures.description: Implement a repair coordinator for a partitioned service mesh where nodes can hold stale membership epochs and delayed lease-renewal messages may arrive after a leader change. Compute a minimal safe set of fencing actions that restores one authoritative membership view without disrupting healthy partitions, and make the procedure converge under duplicate delivery and bounded clock skew.
